_comment: Plan-adjustment (mutation) cases for engine/main.py: a starting checklist (sent as currentChecklist, exactly like the app's update-checklist IPC: messages = [the request only], no stream) plus one request. Item dates are day offsets from the run date ('day'), materialised at run time; 'min' = timeEstimate; 'done' marks finished work (isCompleted + status done + completedAt). expect = what satisfying the request means (scorers.py-style deterministic check in adjust.py). allowed_drops = todo ids the request may remove ('any' for shorten-style requests). id_reuse_ok = ids that may be reused for a reworded step (the step being expanded). prereq_change_ok = the request is about prerequisites. deadline_offset_days is sent as the payload deadline.
